snippet.title: Dread Eagle - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the Reveal Trailer for Dread Eagle, a first-person action-adventure horror game developed by Tarba Paul Cornel and Abdul Rafy. Players will become part of an experiment set in a secret Romanian facility. Explore the depths of the Soviet led trials to uncover the true nature of it and what remains of those who participated. Play alone or with friends in Dread Eagle, coming soon to PC (Steam).

#IGN #Gaming
